Hi there! 👋 Great question about Plant Club billing!

Your Plant Club subscription is charged on the **25th of the previous month**. So if you're subscribed to Plant Club, your card will be charged on the 25th for your box that ships in the first full week of the following month.

For example, your November box would be charged on October 25th, and then ship in the first full week of November.

If you ever need to skip a month, pause, change your plan, or cancel, you can manage all of that from "Account" > "Subscriptions" anytime. Just keep in mind that changes made *before* the 25th will affect your next box, while changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box.

Is there anything else I can help you with today? 🌱
